scope: Official Azuki and Azuki TCG web material used to enrich the Cairn Azuki catalog with world context.

source_policy.official_site_fact: A concise paraphrase of material published on an Azuki-owned web property.
source_policy.official_tcg_rule_fact: A gameplay/world term defined by the official Azuki TCG rules.
source_policy.official_card_fact: A name, element, subtype, rule, flavor, or reference field carried by an official card source.
source_policy.official_future_context: An officially announced but not-yet-released story or set detail; never present it as an already published story event.
source_policy.official_community_governance_context: Material on the official Bobu governance site; proposal intent is not promoted to completed canon unless the page says it shipped.
source_policy.card_art_observation: A visible cue from the catalog image, useful for search but not automatically a canon claim.
source_policy.catalog_inference: A declared relationship inferred from names, subtypes, rules, flavor, or repeated character depiction.

sources.title: Azuki TCG
claims: Gates Awakened asks players to choose Lightning, Water, Earth, or Fire and battle across the Garden and Alley.
Each player leads a faction through a Leader and the mystic power of a Gate.
The site presents every card as hand drawn by artists.

sources.title: How to Play
claims: The Garden is the front row, where combat and most interaction happen.
The Alley is the back row, where preparation happens.
A Gate portals an entity from the Alley into the Garden, and the Gate effect scales with the entity's Gate Power.
IKZ is accumulated and spent to play cards or activate abilities.

sources.title: Azuki TCG Game Rules
claims: Leaders are permanent Garden cards and determine deck element.
Gates are permanent, match the Leader's element, and cannot be attacked or destroyed.
Entities may be played into either the Garden or Alley; weapons attach only in the Garden.
IKZ is a colorless resource, while IKZ tokens are single-use resources.
Neutral cards can be used with any elemental Leader.

sources.title: A Card Game Made by Hand
claims: The TCG bridges Azuki IP and the developing manga with gameplay and physical card art.
The Alley world is contemporary and grounded in everyday life.
The Garden world is fantasy blending feudal Japan with Western fantasy.
Inside the Garden are four elemental domains, each with its own visual flavor.
Element playstyles draw from the identity, culture, and characteristics of their domains.
Card illustrations are designed to express gameplay actions and the feeling of the card.
The visual foundation is East-meets-West, line-art driven, cel-shaded anime art, with additional latitude for alternate and chase art.
Portrait Rare bean foil represents the transient energy of portal travel from the Alley to the Garden.
The Thunderclap alternate art depicts a Beanz in a powerful goddess's hand producing an outsized lightning clap.
Future Set 2 context includes Lightning Cloudreader monks, rain-soaked back alleys, blood-fueled Fire fury, and Earth groves that can nourish or punish.

sources.title: Azuki TCG is headed to Anime Expo 2026
claims: The cards introduced the world, while the announced AZUKI manga will expand where the story goes.
The first announced manga chapters are titled Sisters and Pact.
Shao is a character readers will meet through the manga.
The free global manga launch was announced for September 2026; this snapshot does not treat it as already released.

sources.title: Azuki TCG Card API
claims: The pinned API snapshot supplies official names, elements, categories, subtypes, rules text, rarity, sets, and image URLs for 237 gallery rows.

sources.title: Bobu the Bean Farmer
claims: Bobu presents himself as a sake-drinking bean farmer.
His site says he accidentally burned down a local tavern and frames his fractionalized community as participating in his decisions.
The persona emphasizes farming, drinking, resting, music, mishaps, and community-directed adventures.

sources.title: Bobu Po-Lore-Oid community proposal
claims: The completed governance proposal planned a Chiru-vetted set of Bobu memory prompts and community art for an official canon-lore page.
Example proposal prompts connect Bobu with Yuki, Shao, the Alley, a dojo, an onsen, sloths, bean farming, and drinking games.
These examples record proposal intent; this snapshot does not promote them to published story events.

sources.title: Azuki x H. Moser - Elements of Time
sources.publisher: Azuki Labs and H. Moser & Cie.
claims: The Elementals world is organized around four domains: Earth, Water, Lightning, and Fire.
